svg.title: Endpoint mechanisms: TabM: a parameter-sharing ensemble, TabPFN-3.5: prediction from context, Frozen MoLFormer + ExtraTrees

g.text: Use member-specific factors within layers that share their main weights.
32 members share parameters; these are not 32 independent training runs.
Same W · different rᵢ and sᵢ
Condition a pretrained transformer on eligible labelled training rows.
Native intervals under-cover; input recipes differ across partitions.
Change the representation while keeping the tree endpoint family.
The endpoint remains bounded by its stored leaf values.
